canon.definition: Owner-scoped record {id,user_id,text}; only text is searchable.
Every list/search/delete applies user_id = session user before any other predicate.
Optional decoded query string; absent/empty/whitespace = no filter; >512 bytes = 400 before scanning.
Case-insensitive substring of Note.text (strings.ToLower both sides); no ranking/highlighting.
Non-empty q with zero matches: HTTP 200 + [] and UI search-empty; distinct from base empty (zero notes).
No network: loaded notes stay visible; search disabled; clear works offline; reconnect re-checks via /api/notes.
401 during load: search disabled, notes-empty hidden, no aria-describedby to a hidden node, redirect to /login.
A load superseded by DELETE/create/401 must not resurrect/removed data; generation counter guards responses.
